name: Bind
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Strength against a creature within medium range. On a win, their speed is reduced to 0 until the beginning of your next turn. No effect on a loss.

If the Condition you unchecked was Troubled, you may instead target a creature within long range.
successes:
✨: The target cannot make opportunity attacks until the beginning of your next turn.

✨: The target drops an object it's holding, chosen at random.

🌞: At the beginning of your next turn, repeat the roll against the same target. On a win, reapply the effect; on a loss, it ends. Repeat this on each of your turns until the spell ends.

💀: Check an additional Condition.
